toegepas.rede_vinder: Keeps the 'nie net met ... maar ook met ...' pair parallel.
toegepas.fout: The pair 'nie net met woorde nie maar ook deur kuns' switches preposition halfway, so the contrast reads unbalanced.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both prepositions mean 'by means of' here, so the meaning stays the same and the parallel 'met ... met' reads more cleanly.

toegepas.voor: Ons noem sulke prente op rotse rotskuns.
toegepas.na: Sulke prente op rotse noem ons rotskuns.
toegepas.rede_vinder: Avoids the awkward 'rotse rotskuns' run-on and puts the new term at the end, where it stands out.
toegepas.fout: 'op rotse rotskuns' puts two near-identical words side by side and makes a reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Fronting the object is natural Afrikaans, removes the stumble, keeps the protected word 'rotskuns' unchanged and ends on the new term.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'So' at the start reads as 'in this way'; 'Daarom' makes the intended cause-and-effect link clear.
toegepas.fout: Sentence-initial 'So' copies English 'So,' and can be read as 'in this way' rather than as the consequence it is.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Daarom' states the same cause and effect (we cannot ask the painters, therefore experts read carefully) without ambiguity.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Causal 'oor' is colloquial and can be misread as 'about'; 'vanweë' states the reason plainly.
toegepas.fout: Causal 'oor' after 'geword' is loose spoken usage and can be misread as 'about'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'vanweë' gives the same reason plainly, and no protected name or wording is touched.

toegepas.voor: Dié kultuur sluit hul kennis in van hoe om in die woestyn te oorleef.
toegepas.na: Deel van dié kultuur is hul kennis van hoe om in die woestyn te oorleef.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The separable verb 'sluit ... in' splits the object awkwardly; the rewrite keeps the meaning and reads smoothly into 'Daarby hoort ...'.
toegepas.fout: The separable 'sluit ... in' is split by the object, leaving 'in van hoe om' as an awkward run that reads woodenly.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Deel van dié kultuur is hul kennis' says the same thing, keeps the same referent for 'hul', and flows into 'Daarby hoort ...'.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The countable noun needs the article here to read naturally.
na_skrywer.fout: 'saam erfenis vorm' reads slightly stiff, though 'erfenis' as a mass noun is not strictly ungrammatical.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This rewords a glossary definition beyond a plain grammar error and slightly shifts 'heritage' towards 'a heritage', so only the writer may change it, for every lesson at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Ons noem sulke prente op rotse rotskuns.
vlae.rede: The body sentence names rock art 'prente' (paintings of people and animals), while the decided definition deliberately says 'Kuns' and includes carving ('inkap'), because a later lesson calls some rock art patterns instead of pictures. Changing 'prente' would change content, so it is flagged rather than proposed; a person or the writer should decide whether the body sentence narrows the term.
